scale.severity: 1 negligible, 5 potentially severe rider loss-of-control or structural consequence
scale.likelihood: 1 unlikely with proven hardware, 5 expected without mitigation
scale.detectability: 1 obvious before use, 5 difficult to detect before consequence

risks.failure_mode: axle nut loosens or wheel retention stack loses clamp
risks.effect: wheel loss, axle-thread damage, immediate loss of control
verification: witness-mark inspection before and after rough-surface test

risks.failure_mode: tube pinch, pressure loss, hub fastener error, or incompatible tire/hub stack
prevention: do not treat 9-inch tire as drop-in

risks.failure_mode: axle, hanger, or axle-lock interface yields, bends, slips, or cracks
risks.effect: wheel misalignment or loss of steering control
prevention: guards take impacts before axle/drive where possible

risks.failure_mode: kingpin or shockblock configuration too loose, too stiff, asymmetric, or migrates
risks.effect: speed wobble, poor low-speed steering, unpredictable return-to-center
prevention: front/rear symmetry unless evidence says otherwise

risks.failure_mode: mounting hardware loosens, insert/deck crushes, or deck develops structural damage
risks.effect: truck motion relative to deck or deck failure
prevention: no rider-interface drilling before Rev-B authority
defined fastener inspection and witness marks

risks.failure_mode: insufficient brake torque, pad misalignment, rotor rub, cable slip, or poor rebound
risks.effect: inability to stop predictably or wheel drag/lock

risks.failure_mode: brake fade or rotor/pad heating during extended descent
risks.effect: loss of stopping authority after repeated or prolonged braking
prevention: do not size stopping system from one cold stop
retain regenerative braking only as supplemental heat relief
define descent duty cycle before power freeze
verification: repeat-stop temperature and stopping-distance test in future low-energy commissioning

risks.failure_mode: brake rotor/arm/cable and drivetrain/coupler/guard compete for the same rear-wheel axial or swept volume
risks.effect: interference, compromised brake alignment, or unsafe custom spacer/adaptor
prevention: keep 400 mm brake and 420 mm drive references separate
no custom safety-critical brake spacer unless independently engineered and qualified

risks.failure_mode: motor/gear/belt mount rotates, creeps, bends, or loosens under torque and impacts
risks.effect: drive misalignment, wheel lock, loss of propulsion/braking torque, component contact
prevention: positive anti-rotation where vendor design provides it

risks.effect: tooth/belt/chain damage, bearing overload, wheel lock or drive loss
prevention: select one drive architecture after topology freeze

risks.failure_mode: motor gear/pulley slips on shaft, key/D-flat interface frets, or shaft/circlip migrates
risks.effect: drive loss, rotating-part contact or sudden torque discontinuity
prevention: select motor and drive shaft interface together
no single-grub-screw torque path for trail use

risks.failure_mode: gearbox, belt guard, motor guard, or enclosure strikes terrain before sacrificial skid
risks.effect: drive damage, sudden deceleration, enclosure penetration
verification: curb/root surrogate clearance check at low energy

risks.failure_mode: enclosure mount loosens, cracks, pulls through deck, or transfers impact into battery
risks.effect: battery movement, electrical damage, potential high-energy fault
prevention: received pack envelope before enclosure fabrication
verification: dummy-mass shake/rough-surface fixture before live pack

risks.failure_mode: cable/hose enters wheel, steering, drive, or deck-flex sweep; connector carries structural strain
risks.effect: brake loss, sensor/control loss, short circuit, wheel entanglement
prevention: brake cable/hose routed independently of traction harness

risks.failure_mode: binding/adapter geometry creates poor retention, pressure hotspot, unexpected release, or obstructs emergency step-off
risks.effect: reduced control or lower-limb injury risk
prevention: do not copy generic binding angles

risks.failure_mode: wheel, tube, brake, drive, fuse or sensor cannot be serviced without disturbing unrelated safety-critical assemblies
risks.effect: field repairs become unsafe or maintenance is skipped

risks.failure_mode: vibration loosens structural, brake, drive, binding, guard, or enclosure hardware
risks.effect: progressive misalignment or sudden component separation
prevention: torque/seat procedure where manufacturer values exist
no indiscriminate threadlocker where service/nylon/heat constraints conflict
verification: re-torque investigation if any mark moves

risks.failure_mode: battery/drive placement raises center of mass or biases front/rear loading enough to degrade steering, traction, or brake behavior
risks.effect: poor handling, reduced climb traction, increased rollover/edge-catch tendency
prevention: measure front/rear static wheel loads with dummy power mass
avoid copying production battery size beyond mission need
verification: compare candidate pack locations before enclosure drilling
